title: Automatic Pseudo-Harmful Prompt Generation for Evaluating False Refusals in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component on evaluating moral and ethical boundaries in LLMs. It defines a 'controversial' prompt category that specifically includes topics like religion, abortion, and the boundaries of free speech. Furthermore, it benchmarks how models apply safety and ethical alignment rules (such as those regarding stereotypes, animal abuse, and social values) to distinguish between truly harmful content and pseudo-harmful (harmless or gray-area) content.
